words.defn_en: to predict or foretell a future event:

sentences.en: Economists ______ that prices will keep rising throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家預言物價將在這一年持續上漲。

sentences.en: It is difficult to ______ exactly when the storm will hit the coast.
sentences.zh: 很難準確預言暴風雨何時會侵襲海岸。

sentences.en: The government plans to ______ the new tax law next month.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在下個月頒布這項新的稅法。

sentences.en: The committee will ______ the updated safety guidelines to all employees.
sentences.zh: 委員會將向所有員工公布更新後的安全準則。

sentences.en: The fortune teller said it was a ______ time to start a new business.
sentences.zh: 算命師說現在是創業的吉利時機。

sentences.en: Clear skies and calm winds made conditions ______ for the launch.
sentences.zh: 晴朗的天空與平靜的風勢使發射條件十分有利。

sentences.en: The old oak tree has produced countless ______ scattered throughout the forest.
sentences.zh: 這棵老橡樹已經產下無數散布在森林各處的後代。

sentences.en: The king hoped his ______ would rule the kingdom for generations to come.
sentences.zh: 國王希望他的後代子孫能世世代代統治這個王國。

sentences.en: His ______ spending habits left him deeply in debt within a few years.
sentences.zh: 他揮霍無度的消費習慣讓他在幾年內就債台高築。

sentences.en: The company was criticized for its ______ use of shareholder funds.
sentences.zh: 這家公司因揮霍股東資金而受到批評。

words.defn_en: the act of banning certain behavior:

sentences.en: The city passed a ______ on smoking in public parks.
sentences.zh: 市政府通過了一項禁止在公園吸菸的法令。

sentences.en: The ______ of alcohol in the 1920s led to widespread bootlegging.
sentences.zh: 1920年代的禁酒令導致私釀私售酒類的行為十分猖獗。

sentences.en: The young violinist was hailed as a musical ______.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的小提琴手被譽為音樂神童。

sentences.en: He was a chess ______, winning tournaments before the age of ten.
sentences.zh: 他是個西洋棋神童,不到十歲就贏得多項錦標賽冠軍。

sentences.en: Rumors tend to ______ quickly on social media.
sentences.zh: 謠言在社群媒體上往往傳播得很快。

sentences.en: Gardeners often ______ plants by taking cuttings from a healthy stem.
sentences.zh: 園丁經常透過剪取健康莖枝來繁殖植物。

sentences.en: The child displayed ______ talent at the piano from a young age.
sentences.zh: 這個孩子從小就展現出驚人的鋼琴天賦。

sentences.en: The company reported a ______ increase in profits this quarter.
sentences.zh: 這家公司公布本季獲利出現驚人的成長。

sentences.en: The loss of her father had a ______ effect on her writing.
sentences.zh: 父親的離世對她的寫作產生了深刻的影響。

sentences.en: He offered a ______ insight into the nature of grief.
sentences.zh: 他對悲傷的本質提出了深刻的見解。

sentences.en: She has a ______ for choosing the most difficult path.
sentences.zh: 她總是傾向於選擇最艱難的那條路。

sentences.en: He showed an early ______ toward music and rhythm.
sentences.zh: 他從小就展現出對音樂與節奏的天生傾向。

sentences.en: He tends to ______ until the night before a deadline.
sentences.zh: 他總是習慣拖到截止日期前一晚才動手。

sentences.en: She promised herself she would stop ______ing on her thesis.
sentences.zh: 她告訴自己不再拖延撰寫論文。

sentences.en: He ______ed his hand in a gesture of peace.
sentences.zh: 他伸出手,做出一個和平的示意動作。

sentences.en: The company ______ed a generous settlement to avoid a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 這家公司提出了一筆優渥的和解金,以避免訴訟。

sentences.en: He offered ______ apologies for arriving so late.
sentences.zh: 他為自己遲到這麼久而不斷致歉。

sentences.en: The garden was covered in a ______ display of spring flowers.
sentences.zh: 這座花園裡開滿了大量的春花。

sentences.en: The ______ heir spent his entire inheritance within a few years.
sentences.zh: 這位揮霍無度的繼承人在短短幾年內就把整筆遺產花光了。

sentences.en: His ______ spending habits eventually led him to bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 他揮霍無度的花錢習慣最終讓他走向破產。

words.defn_en: acting in anticipation of future problems rather than reacting to them:
words.root_note: pro- (before) + active, from Latin agere (to act)

sentences.en: The company took a ______ approach to preventing workplace accidents.
sentences.zh: 這家公司採取積極主動的方式來預防職場意外事故。

sentences.en: She encouraged her students to be ______ about their own learning.
sentences.zh: 她鼓勵學生對自己的學習抱持積極主動的態度。

sentences.en: The president will ______ the new law during the ceremony tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 總統將於明天的典禮上宣布這項新法律。

sentences.en: The king ______ a new law.
sentences.zh: 國王頒布了一項新法律。

sentences.en: He has always had a ______ for taking unnecessary risks.
sentences.zh: 他一直有著承擔不必要風險的傾向。

sentences.en: Her ______ toward perfectionism sometimes slowed down the entire team.
sentences.zh: 她對完美主義的執著有時會拖慢整個團隊的進度。

sentences.en: The chef managed to ______ rare ingredients from a local farmer.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚設法從一位當地農夫那裡取得了稀有食材。

sentences.en: The company hired an agent to ______ office supplies at a discount.
sentences.zh: 這家公司聘請了一位代理商以優惠價格採購辦公用品。

sentences.en: The Ford factory ______ thousands of cars each year.
sentences.zh: 福特工廠每年生產數千輛汽車。

sentences.en: This region's soil is fertile enough to ______ two crops a year.
sentences.zh: 這個地區的土壤十分肥沃,足以一年生產兩季作物。

sentences.en: The comedian's ______ language shocked the more conservative members of the audience.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員粗俗不堪的言語讓觀眾中較為保守的人士感到震驚。

sentences.en: He was asked to leave the church for his ______ remarks during the service.
sentences.zh: 他因在儀式中發表褻瀆的言論而被要求離開教堂。

sentences.en: The garden had a ______ of flowers every spring.
sentences.zh: 這座花園每年春天都會開滿大量的花朵。

sentences.en: The buffet offered a ______ of dishes from around the world.
sentences.zh: 這場自助餐提供了種類豐富、來自世界各地的菜餚。

words.defn_en: a forecast, especially regarding the likely course of a disease:

sentences.en: The doctor gave a cautiously optimistic ______ after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 這位醫生在這場手術後給出了謹慎樂觀的預後評估。

sentences.en: Economists offered a grim ______ for the coming recession.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家對這場即將到來的經濟衰退給出了嚴峻的預測。

words.defn_en: indicating the likely future course of something:

sentences.en: Doctors identified several ______ factors for the disease's progression.
sentences.zh: 醫生找出了幾項這種疾病病程發展的預測性因素。

sentences.en: The dark clouds served as a ______ sign of the coming storm.
sentences.zh: 這片烏雲成了即將到來的暴風雨的預兆徵象。

sentences.en: The economist's ______ about the market proved accurate.
sentences.zh: 這位經濟學家對這個市場的預測結果被證明是準確的。

sentences.en: Ancient astrologers based their ______ s on the movement of stars.
sentences.zh: 古代占星家將他們的預言建立在星辰運行之上。

words.defn_en: a person who predicts future events:

sentences.en: The weather ______ warned of an unusually harsh winter ahead.
sentences.zh: 這位氣象預測者警告即將到來一個異常嚴酷的冬天。

sentences.en: He earned a reputation as a skilled financial ______ .
sentences.zh: 他贏得了熟練的財經預測者的名聲。

words.defn_en: an introductory section of a novel or other literary work:

sentences.en: The novel's ______ hints at a tragedy that will unfold later in the story.
sentences.zh: 這部小說的序言暗示了故事後續將展開的一場悲劇。

sentences.en: She skipped the ______ and went straight to the first chapter.
sentences.zh: 她跳過了序言,直接翻到第一章。

sentences.en: He tried to ______ the meeting from one hour to two.
sentences.zh: 他試圖將會議時間從一小時延長到兩小時。

sentences.en: Doctors say a healthy diet can ______ your life expectancy.
sentences.zh: 醫生表示,健康的飲食能夠延長你的預期壽命。

sentences.en: Marie Curie was a ______ scientist who won many awards.
sentences.zh: 瑪麗·居禮是一位知名的科學家,曾獲得許多獎項。

sentences.en: The scandal involved several ______ business leaders.
sentences.zh: 這起醜聞牽涉到好幾位知名的企業領袖。

words.defn_en: a person who advocates or supports a cause or idea:

sentences.en: She was a leading ______ of environmental conservation.
sentences.zh: 她是環境保護運動的主要提倡者。

sentences.en: The environmentalist was a ______ of renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 這位環保人士是再生能源的支持者。

words.defn_en: to forbid, especially by law; to condemn or outlaw:

sentences.en: The government decided to ______ the use of the harmful chemical.
sentences.zh: 政府決定禁止使用這種有害的化學物質。

sentences.en: Local laws ______ the sale of alcohol on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 當地法律禁止在星期日銷售酒類。

words.defn_en: conduct legal proceedings against a defendant:

sentences.en: The district attorney decided to ______ the case despite limited evidence.
sentences.zh: 儘管證據有限,這位地區檢察官仍決定起訴這起案件。

sentences.en: Prosecutors vowed to ______ anyone involved in the fraud scheme.
sentences.zh: 檢方誓言要起訴任何涉入這起詐欺案的人。

words.defn_en: the possibility of something happening in the future; a potential customer:

sentences.en: The ______ of a promotion motivated her to work harder.
sentences.zh: 升遷的前景激勵她更加努力工作。

sentences.en: The sales team followed up with each promising ______ .
sentences.zh: 銷售團隊對每位有潛力的客戶進行了後續追蹤。

sentences.en: Miriam's rude words ______ an argument.
sentences.zh: 米瑞安無禮的話語引發了一場爭吵。

sentences.en: The controversial painting was designed to ______ discussion.
sentences.zh: 這幅具爭議性的畫作是刻意設計來激發討論的。
